title: Single-output Anenji 4200 24 V control report
summary: Owner reports LCD/read/write comparisons on a single-output April 2025 24 V unit, layout 1 and model 0x3501, with Li4/BMS. The model overlay adds reported settings at 330, 338, 339, 341-343 and 351, discrete nominal output choices and SUF. This is user-reported evidence, not a maintainer hardware test or evidence for the distinct layout-11 4200 variant. Battery-type write function, immediate equalization, conflicting voltage limits and unknown program registers still need clarification.
